title: 宣州谢朓楼饯别校书叔云
titlePy: Xuān Zhōu Xiè Tiǎo Lóu Jiàn Bié Jiào Shū Shū Yún
titleEn: Farewell to Uncle Yun, the Collator, at Xie Tiao’s Tower in Xuanzhou
author: 李白
intro: At a farewell party in a high tower, Li Bai pours out his frustration, soars into dreams of grabbing the moon, then crashes back down. It contains one of the most quoted lines about sorrow in Chinese: “Cut water with a knife, and it flows on; drink to drown your grief, and the grief grows.”
analysis: 这是李白在宣州谢朓楼上为族叔李云送行时写的诗。开头两句很长，像一声叹息：抛弃我离去的，是留不住的昨天；扰乱我心情的，是今天这么多烦恼。可接下来情绪一转：万里长风送着南飞的秋雁，面对这样的景色，正好在高楼上痛快喝酒。然后他夸对方，也夸自己：你的文章有汉代的风骨，我的诗像谢朓一样清新俊逸（谢朓是南朝诗人，这座楼就是他建的）。两人都满怀豪情，想飞上青天去摘明月。可是理想和现实的距离太大，心情又跌下来：“抽刀断水水更流，举杯销愁愁更愁。”用刀砍水，水照样流；用酒浇愁，愁反而更多——这个比喻新鲜又准确，成了千古名句。最后诗人说：人活在世上不如意，不如明天散开头发，划着小船去江湖上漂流。全诗情绪大起大落，正是李白豪放的风格。
analysisEn: Li Bai wrote this at a farewell party for a clansman, Li Yun, in Xie Tiao’s Tower in Xuanzhou. It opens with two long, sighing lines: what has left me is yesterday, which cannot be kept; what troubles my heart is today, so full of worries. Then the mood lifts: a wind blowing ten thousand miles carries the autumn geese south — a perfect sight to drink to in a high tower. He praises his friend and himself: your writing has the strength of the Han masters, and my poems are as fresh as those of Xie Tiao, the fifth-century poet who built this very tower. Both of them are full of soaring feelings, wanting to fly up to the sky and take hold of the moon. But the dream is too far from reality, and he falls back to earth: “Cut water with a knife, and it only flows on; raise a cup to drown your grief, and the grief only grows.” The comparison is fresh and exact, and it is still quoted all the time. In the end he decides that, since life in this world goes against his wishes, tomorrow he will let down his hair and drift away in a little boat. The wild rise and fall of feeling is Li Bai at his most typical.
background: Li Bai (701–762) is traditionally said to have written this in Xuanzhou (in today’s Anhui) around 753, about ten years after leaving the court in Chang’an. Some versions give a different title, and scholars disagree about who the farewell was for.
pronunciation: 朓 tiǎo；饯别 jiàn；校书 jiào shū（不读 xiào）；酣 hān；蓬莱 péng lái；中间 jiān；清发 fā；俱 jù；逸兴 xìng；壮思 sī（旧读 sì，网站按今音）；称意 chèn（不读 chēng）；明朝 zhāo；散发 sàn fà（披散头发）；扁舟 piān zhōu（不读 biǎn）；更流、更愁 gèng。
version: 采用通行文本。“欲上青天览明月”的“览”，一些选本作“揽”（摘取），意思更直观；“举杯销愁”一作“举杯消愁”。题目一作《陪侍御叔华登楼歌》，网站用通行题目。文本与维基文库本一致。

lines.zh: 弃我去者，昨日之日不可留；
lines.rhythm: 弃我/去者，昨日/之日/不可留
lines.py: qì wǒ qù zhě, zuó rì zhī rì bù kě liú
lines.lit: What abandons me and leaves — yesterday’s days cannot be kept;
lines.en: What has left me is yesterday — it cannot be held back;

lines.zh: 乱我心者，今日之日多烦忧。
lines.rhythm: 乱我/心者，今日/之日/多烦忧
lines.py: luàn wǒ xīn zhě, jīn rì zhī rì duō fán yōu
lines.lit: what disturbs my heart — today’s days hold many troubles and worries.
lines.en: what troubles my heart is today, so full of cares.

lines.py: cháng fēng wàn lǐ sòng qiū yàn
lines.lit: A long wind of ten thousand li sends off the autumn geese;
lines.en: A wind ten thousand miles long sends the autumn geese south —

lines.py: duì cǐ kě yǐ hān gāo lóu
lines.lit: facing this, we may drink deeply in the high tower.
lines.en: a sight to drink to, high in this tower.

lines.py: péng lái wén zhāng jiàn ān gǔ
lines.lit: Your writing, of the Penglai library, has Jian’an bones;
lines.en: Your prose has the backbone of the old Han masters,

lines.py: zhōng jiān xiǎo xiè yòu qīng fā
lines.lit: and in between, Little Xie is again fresh and bright.
lines.en: and mine, like Xie Tiao’s, comes out clear and fresh.

lines.py: jù huái yì xìng zhuàng sī fēi
lines.lit: Both of us hold soaring moods, our bold thoughts flying;
lines.en: We both burn with high spirits, our thoughts take wing —

lines.py: yù shàng qīng tiān lǎn míng yuè
lines.lit: we want to go up to the blue sky and take the bright moon.
lines.en: we want to climb the blue sky and gather in the moon.

lines.py: chōu dāo duàn shuǐ shuǐ gèng liú
lines.lit: Draw a knife to cut the water — the water flows on all the more;
lines.en: Cut water with a blade, and it only flows on;

lines.py: jǔ bēi xiāo chóu chóu gèng chóu
lines.lit: raise a cup to dissolve sorrow — the sorrow grows more sorrowful.
lines.en: drink to drown your sorrow, and the sorrow only grows.

lines.py: rén shēng zài shì bù chèn yì
lines.lit: Living in this world, things do not go as I wish;
lines.en: Since this life will not go the way I want,

lines.py: míng zhāo sàn fà nòng piān zhōu
lines.lit: tomorrow morning, hair let loose, I will play in a small boat.
lines.en: tomorrow I’ll loosen my hair and drift off in a little boat.

words.note: 设酒送行。现代汉语有“饯行”，书面语。
官名，负责校对图书。“校”读 jiào，如“校对”。

words.en: to drink to one’s heart’s content
words.note: 痛快地喝酒。现代汉语有“酣畅淋漓”“酣睡”。
蓬莱是传说中的仙山，东汉人把皇家藏书处比作蓬莱，这里借指李云的文章。
建安是东汉末年号，曹操父子等人的诗刚健有力，后人称“建安风骨”。
南朝诗人谢朓，人称“小谢”，以区别于前辈谢灵运。
清新秀发，形容诗风。现代汉语不这么用。
通“揽”，摘取。现代汉语“览”是看（“游览”），“揽”是拿、抱（“揽在怀里”）。

words.en: to cut water with a knife
words.note: 今天常和下句连用，比喻办法不对、愁苦解不掉。
现代汉语常写“借酒消愁”，是常用成语。
“朝”读 zhāo，早晨。现代汉语说“明天”；读 cháo 就成了“明朝（朝代）”。
古人束发戴冠，散开头发表示不做官、自由自在。今天“散发”（sàn fā）是“发出”的意思，不同。

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 长风送秋雁南飞，开阔的秋景让诗人的心情一下子豪放起来，也暗合送别。
imagery.en: Geese carried south on a long wind — a wide autumn view that lifts the poet’s spirits, and a quiet echo of someone leaving.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 想上青天摘明月，明月代表高远、纯洁的理想。
imagery.en: Wanting to climb the sky and take the moon: the moon stands for a lofty, pure ideal.

imagery.name: 水
imagery.zh: 流水砍不断，比喻愁绪绵绵不绝、无法消除。
imagery.en: Water that cannot be cut — sorrow that keeps flowing and cannot be stopped.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 先是高楼痛饮的豪兴，后是借酒消愁反而更愁。
imagery.en: First the joy of drinking in the high tower, then the discovery that wine only deepens grief.
